newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Notionnel chase Bunds, 128.82 key support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Notionnel chase Bunds, 128.82 key support.

text.p: MATIF September notionnel futures continue to follow Bunds, and while 128.82 support holds, the contract is likely to be forming a base on Thursday for further upside action, technical analysts said.
Natalie Fillet, strategist at Banque Paribas in Paris, said Monday's burst higher from a low of 128.44 was considered positive.
"The next level of resistance is 129.20, and if it breaks that it will head to 129.40," Fillet said.
By 0750 GMT, September notionnel were 0.04 higher at 129.18.
Notionnel face a small overhead supply at around 129.20 which is near the top of the current range. The next band from mid-June comes in around 129.40.
Below Monday's high of 129.82, Fillet pegged support at 128.70, the high on June 20.
Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase in London, said the September notionnel chart mirrored Bunds.
"It looks as if the correction could be over. We're now at a key stage where we hold above key support levels," he said.
"There is a corrective bottom in place for Bunds and notionnel," he added.
Stannard said initial support came in at 129.02, the bottom end of the consolidation range that developed on Wednesday.
"If we get a break below there, that will leave notionnel vulnerable to further corrective pressure in the near term," Stannard said.
But the key level to watch was 128.82 which should hold to maintain the recovery from the 128.42 low on Friday.

"At this stage we would be looking for notionnel to hold above there," Stannard added. On the upside, Thursday's breach of 129.24 paved the way for gains toward 129.52, the June 16 top. September Pibor stood 0.03 higher on the day at 96.61.
